title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HUTT, SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to renaming the Slauson Connect Center to the "Curren D. Price, Jr. Youth and Community Center".
text:
[Council File 26-1575]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HUTT, SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to renaming the Slauson Connect Center to the "Curren D. Price, Jr. Youth and Community Center".
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
INSTRUCT the General Services Department, or any other relevant department, to rename the Slauson Connect Center, the "Curren D. Price, Jr. Youth and Community Center" and install signage as appropriate.
